title: How do I remove someone from a split payment?
summary: Explains the procedure to remove a participant from a split payment: confirm whether they already paid, check how removal affects your participant count (30 cap), remove them from split details, confirm and review allocations, cancel any outstanding request, and reallocate their share among remaining members. Includes guidance on inviting a replacement and documenting the change with a note.
